summary: Practise Scrum and Kanban backlog, workflow and flow-measure techniques. Explore the five-day course and strengthen your software delivery practice.
lede: Agile development methodologies help software and product teams plan, organize and inspect work using Scrum and Kanban. For developers, product owners, delivery leads and other team members, the course covers refining backlog items, setting Sprint Goals and applying work-in-progress limits. You also practise interpreting cycle-time and throughput evidence, identifying blockers on digital boards and using reviews to plan improvements.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for people who shape, build, test or coordinate software and digital product work, including teams beginning to use Scrum or Kanban.
prerequisites: No prior Scrum or Kanban training is required. Familiarity with team-based software or product delivery is useful; coding is not required.
